`router-migrate finish .` passed. Summary of the migration:

**Architecture**: this plugin registers ~15 selectable LLM providers (`LLMProviders/index.ts`), each its own LangChain wrapper class or raw-fetch "Custom" provider, picked by the user in Settings.

**Outcomes (132 worklist items, all claimed):**
- **`migrated` (7, unconfirmed by the local simulator but not overridden)**: OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Agent (thinking models), and Anthropic Chat providers — each is a vendor-branded LangChain class (`ChatOpenAI`/`ChatAnthropic`) defaulting to the vendor's own host with the operator's key; the "Base Path" field is an override valve, not a provider switchboard. Also the global `default-settings.ts` endpoint, which mirrors that OpenAI default.
- **`kept R_OTHER_HOST` (22)**: Azure, Google (GenerativeAI/PaLM), Mistral, Together, Perplexity, Ollama, MiniMax (OpenAI/Anthropic-*compatible* but hosted by MiniMax), and the two generic "Custom"/"Anthropic Legacy (Custom)" providers whose endpoint is a free-text settings field meant for arbitrary hosts.
- **`kept R_NO_ENDPOINT` (part of the 22)**: OpenAI Instruct (legacy Completions API) and the Whisper audio-transcription path — neither surface is served by Router.
- **`handoff R_RAW_REQUESTS` (2)**: the two "list available models" helpers (`chatanthropic.tsx`, `utils.tsx`) that hit `/models` via Obsidian's raw `request()` API instead of an SDK or `fetch`.
- **`not_a_site` (91)**: the static `AI_MODELS` pricing/token catalog (74 entries), local token-counting arithmetic in every provider's `calcTokens`/`calcPrice`, a one-time settings-migration helper, a test file, and a text-splitter import — none of these construct or send a request.

No code was edited — the floor's codemod found zero wrappable `new OpenAI(`/`new Anthropic(` constructions (this repo only uses LangChain wrapper classes and raw `fetch`), so every decision here was a judgment claim rather than a wrap.
